summary_en: SmartDrive inc. authorized acquisition of up to 400,000 shares (1.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥100 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 to February 12, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, SmartDrive inc.'s board of directors approved the acquisition of up to 400,000 ordinary shares, representing 1.1% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum of ¥100 million. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 16, 2026 to February 12, 2027, based on Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied by Article 165(3).

The company stated that the buyback aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while securing flexibility for future capital allocation decisions. The authorization reflects management's assessment of current stock price trends and the company's financial position. As of September 30, 2026, SmartDrive held 700,228 treasury shares against 37,264,292 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
